title: One candle, four prices
desc: Open, high, low and close: what every candle tells you

cards.title: Where did it end the day?
cards.situation: This green candle is one day of trading. Where did the price close?

items.label: A green candle with four unknown prices

options.text: $108, the top of the thin line
options.feedback: The thin line is the wick. It shows how high price went, not where it ended.

options.text: $105, the top of the thick part
options.feedback: The thick part is the body. On a green candle, its top is the close.
The bottom of the lower wick is the day’s low. On a green candle, the close is the top of the body.

cards.work: Green = it closed above where it opened. Top of the body = close = $105. The thin line above reaches the day’s high, $108.

cards.title: One candle, four prices
cards.text: Each candle shows **[[ohlc|open, high, low and close]]**. The thick body runs from open to close. The thin [[wick|wicks]] reach the high and the low.

blocks.tip: {up}Green{/up}: it closed above its open. {down}Red{/down}: it closed below.

cards.title: A line hides the fight
cards.text: A line chart only joins the closes. Candles also show how far price swung before it settled.

items.title: Line
items.label: A line through the seven closes: day 3 just dips to $99

chart.label: Seven candles: on day 3 price fell to $97, then closed at $99

cards.foot: Day 3: the line just dips. The candle shows price fell to $97, then buyers pulled it back to $99.

cards.title: Read the red candle
cards.q: It opened at $50, went up to $51 and down to $45. Where did it close?

items.label: A red candle: open $50, high $51, low $45, close unknown

options.feedback: $51 is the high, the top of the upper wick. Price only touched it.
$50 is the open, the top of the red body. A red candle closes below its open.
A red body runs from the open at the top down to the close at the bottom: $46.
$45 is the low, the bottom of the wick. A red body ends at the close.

cards.work: Red body: open $50 at the top, close $46 at the bottom.

cards.title: The long top wick
cards.q: A candle has a long upper wick and closes near where it opened. What happened?

items.label: A small green body at the bottom with a long upper wick

options.text: Buyers pushed it up, then sellers pushed it back
options.feedback: The long wick is a round trip: buyers took price far up, and sellers pushed it back before the close.
The body is small, but the wick shows price went far up before it came back.
A closed market makes no candle at all. This one shows a big move up and back.
If sellers had won all day, you’d see a long red body. This candle closed near its open.

cards.headline: You can read any candle.
lines: Each candle shows open, high, low and close.
Green closes above its open, red below.
Wicks show how far price went, and got pushed back.
